metadata.title: Under Ricci flow, a 3-torus goes flat
metadata.abstract: We determine the long-time behavior of the canonical Ricci flow on a closed three-manifold of Thurston type $\mathbb{R}^3$, Nil, or Sol, starting from an arbitrary initial metric. In the Euclidean case, the metric $g(t)$ converges exponentially fast to a flat metric. The Gromov--Hausdorff limit of $(M,t^{-1}g(t))$ is a point in the Euclidean and Nil cases, and a metric circle or a compact interval of positive length in the Sol case. In all three cases, the blowdown flows lifted to the universal cover, $s^{-1}\widetilde g(sτ)$, converge, in the pointed Cheeger--Hamilton sense, to an explicit homogeneous expanding Ricci soliton

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 确定任意初始度量下，Thurston 型为 $\mathbb R^3$、Nil 或 Sol 的闭三流形之标准 Ricci 流长期行为。
analysis.breakthrough: 欧氏型指数收敛到平坦度量，并逐一识别三个类型的缩放 Gromov--Hausdorff 极限与通用覆盖 blowdown。
analysis.limitations: 分类限于三种几何化类型；Sol 情形的极限仍可能依初始数据形成圆或区间。
analysis.priorityReason: 100 分制：相关性 24/30、新颖性与强度 18/25、技术复用性 14/20、潜在影响 10/15、证据清晰度 8/10，总分 74/100。
